concept: A person-chosen, revocable supporter relationship remains intact across entry, queue, route, service, failure and evacuation without granting proxy authority.
continuity_gates: purpose and limits explained in an understandable form
supporter receives no automatic proxy, signature, identity or data authority
entry, queue, route, service and AI-off fallback recognize the temporary pass
private coercion check is available without penalty
immediate-danger split has a named commander and executable reunion plan
revocation deletes the temporary relation while preserving the person's pending matter

human_roles.service_continuity_lead: preserves joint passage, queue position and pending matter
human_roles.emergency_commander: may order only an immediate-danger split and owns reunification
human_roles.independent_reviewer: handles complaints, negative records, deletion and closure evidence

ai_minimum_role: warn that the next step may split the pass
ai_forbidden_roles: infer disability, diagnosis, kinship, guardianship, dependency or coercion
privacy: no diagnosis or relationship proof in public status
stop_conditions: the person cannot privately confirm a choice
joint passage would create an unmanaged immediate danger
queue or pending matter cannot be preserved
reunion plan lacks a named owner
public_result_on_stop: Do not force solo continuation; do not record lateness or abandonment; do not cancel queue position; do not close the pending matter. Move to a human route and preserve an executable reunion option.

five_field_difference_audit.served_unit: the person plus a person-chosen, revocable supporter as a temporary service unit
five_field_difference_audit.whole_task: declare, issue minimal pass, move together, confirm before split, handle private safety exception, survive AI-off, revoke/delete, reunify
five_field_difference_audit.spatial_carrier: equivalent entry, parallel queue, service anteroom, private check point, human desk and visible reunion point
five_field_difference_audit.rights: person chooses and revokes; no automatic proxy; named service, privacy, emergency and review roles
five_field_difference_audit.failure_result: no forced solo continuation or penalty; preserve queue, pending matter, paper fallback and reunion
five_field_difference_audit.result: No reviewed neighbor closes all five fields; re-audit before every review request.

status_boundary: Synthetic tabletop protocol only; not a legal duty, approved service rule, field result or emergency plan.
